rv.q: Eleanor Rhode’s ravishing fusion of flamboyancy, surrealism and raucous fun rouses audiences in a youthful, energetic riot.
Mathew Baynton brings energy and easy-going charm to this breezy, diverting comedy
I would recommend a trip to Stratford for this gem of a show.
It's a trippy, psychedelic '60s teenage dreamworld that director Eleanor Rhode conceives: far from leafy tradition but highly entertaining.

cn.t: Rhode's psychedelic production dazzles with flamboyant visuals and raucous energy, though poetry takes a backseat to spectacle. Critics praise the youthful, surrealist reimagining as highly entertaining and joyful.
